description: Searches text or a regular expression across project files and returns file paths with line numbers, one entry per line that holds the query, however often it holds it; total_matches counts those lines. What the engine steps over is not searched: directories spelled with a dot, node_modules, and any directory holding a .gdignore, which not_searched names when the search passed one. A vendored engine or an export directory is therefore absent from the results rather than matching the code you are looking for in a copy nobody runs. The addons gdharness installed are not searched either, since nobody on the project wrote them.

fileTypes.description: Extensions to search, such as ["gd", "tscn"]. Default: every text file. When none of the files searched has one of them, note says so and names the extensions there are.

path.description: A folder or file inside the project to search, such as "res://src". Default: the whole project. One that is not there is refused, naming the project's folders.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

query.description: The text or pattern to find.

regex.description: Read the query as a regular expression. Default false.

name: project_search
title: Search the project
